description:
Why this issue exists: server.rs route_method() and related helpers use .unwrap_or(json!({})) to default missing JMAP arguments to an empty object. This allocates a new serde_json::Value on the happy path and obscures the Option flow. The idiomatic Rust alternative is to use .as_object().and_then(...) or .unwrap_or_else(|| &Value::Object(Default::default())) for zero-allocation default.

What needs to be done: Replace .unwrap_or(json!({})) call sites with Option chaining (.and_then / .unwrap_or_else) or extract the arguments as &Value and pass a reference to a static empty object constant.
title: idiom: .unwrap_or(json!({})) used instead of Option chaining in route_method
